summary: You can rename groups safely, and the replication choice is simpler.

new.title: Rename a group or administrative unit
new.text: In All records you can rename a group or administrative unit, including its tag. Every row that uses it is updated in the same change when you commit.

fixes.title: Deleting a group shows what else goes
fixes.text: Before, deleting a group left rows pointing at nothing. You now see exactly which rows use it and can remove them together or cancel.

fixes.title: Replication is a simple two-way choice
fixes.text: Choose Replicate to managed tenants or No replication. The old Follow option meant the same as No replication and is gone; what is sent is unchanged.
